technology_title: Prefusion-Stabilized Coronavirus Spike Proteins (2P Proline Mutation)
expected_inventors: Barney S. Graham; Jason S. McLellan; Andrew B. Ward; Robert W. Kirchdoerfer; Christopher A. Cottrell; Michael Gordon Joyce; Masaru Kanekiyo; Nianshuang Wang; Jesper Pallesen; Hadi M. Yassine; Hannah L. Turner; Kizzmekia Corbett
notes: Foundational 2P mutation licensed non-exclusively during pandemic emergency to Moderna, BioNTech, Janssen, Novavax; co-assigned to Dartmouth College, Scripps Research, and NIH/NIAID.

technology_title: Synthetic Oleanane Triterpenoids (CDDO and Derivatives) for Chemoprevention and Anti-Inflammation
expected_inventors: Michael B. Sporn; Gordon W. Gribble; Tadashi Honda; Nanjoo Suh
notes: Foundational IP exclusively licensed to Reata Pharmaceuticals; spawned FDA approval of Omaveloxolone (Skyclarys) for Friedreich's ataxia and startup Triterpenoid Therapeutics (TTX); Dartmouth ran competitive auction selling future royalty stream.

technology_title: V-Domain Ig Suppressor of T Cell Activation (VISTA) Regulatory T Cell Mediator
expected_inventors: Randolph J. Noelle; Li Wang
notes: Negative checkpoint regulator discovered at Geisel School of Medicine; patented and licensed to ImmuNext, which later spun off Lifordi Immunotherapeutics.

technology_title: Anti-CD154 (anti-CD40L) Engineered Antibodies for Autoimmune Disease and Immunotherapy (Frexalimab)
expected_inventors: Jay Rothstein; Robert George Edward Holgate; Arron Hearn; Randolph J. Noelle
notes: Fc-engineered to eliminate thromboembolic clotting complications seen in earlier 1st-generation antibodies; licensed by ImmuNext to Sanofi (Frexalimab for MS) and royalty rights acquired by Royalty Pharma.

technology_title: Breast Cancer Locator (BCL) System: Patient-Specific Guides and 3D Visualizer for Surgical Resection
expected_inventors: Venkataramanan Krishnaswamy; Richard J. Barth; Keith D. Paulsen
notes: Spun out into CairnSurgical; translates supine MRI scans into 3D-printed patient-specific physical guides to eliminate positive margins in breast lumpectomies; negotiated under TTO equity-only license.

technology_title: BeamSite: Real-Time Cherenkov Optical Imaging for Radiation Therapy Verification
expected_inventors: Brian W. Pogue; Petr Bruza; David J. Gladstone
notes: Spun out into DoseOptics LLC; time-gated camera system images faint Cherenkov light produced in patient tissue during radiation therapy; FDA-cleared and in worldwide clinical use.

technology_title: InSight Surgical: Quantitative Hyperspectral and Fluorescence Guidance for Brain Tumor Resection
expected_inventors: David W. Roberts; Keith D. Paulsen; Pablo A. Valdes; Frederic Leblond; Brian C. Wilson; Michael Jermyn
notes: Spun out into InSight Surgical Technologies (IST); intraoperative fluorescence guidance (qF-Image) co-registered with surgical microscopes to distinguish brain tumor margins from healthy tissue in real time.

technology_title: Quanta Image Sensor (QIS) with High Sensitivity and Sub-Electron Read Noise
expected_inventors: Eric R. Fossum; Donald Hondongwa; Jiaju Ma
notes: Spun out into Gigajot Technology by Fossum and PhD students; 3rd-generation imaging sensor sensitive enough to count single photons at room temperature without avalanche multiplication.

technology_title: High-Efficiency Resonant Coils with Integrated Capacitance for Wireless Power Transfer (Aurion WPT)
expected_inventors: Phyo Aung Kyaw; Aaron Stein; Charles R. Sullivan
notes: Spun out into Resonant Link; multi-layer self-resonant coil structure delivering high-speed wireless power; industrial charging business acquired in 2025 by ACT; medical implant line retained.

technology_title: OsteoSmartSense: Electrical Impedance Sensing Dental and Orthopedic Drill System
expected_inventors: Ryan Halter; Rebecca Butler; Michael Salin; Alicia Everitt
notes: Spun out into AssurTek Surgical (founded 2023); integrates bioimpedance spectroscopy directly into dental/orthopedic drill bit to detect cortical/cancellous bone boundaries and automatically halt drilling before striking nerves or sinuses.

technology_title: Molecularly Imprinted Polymer Sensors for Airborne Contaminants and Nicotine Detection
expected_inventors: Joseph J. BelBruno; Sadik Antwi-Boampong
notes: Spun out into FreshAir Sensor LLC; molecularly imprinted polymers detect nicotine and marijuana metabolites in air; pivoted to include vaping aerosols; widely deployed in hotels and public housing.

technology_title: Systems and Methods for Cell Capture Biomarker Detection and Contact-Free Cell Lysis
expected_inventors: Amogha Tadimety; Alison Burklund; Timothy J. Palinski; John X.J. Zhang
notes: Spun out into Nanopath; amplicon-free molecular diagnostic platform identifying pathogens (UTIs, vaginitis, HPV) in 15-20 min; granted FDA Breakthrough Device designation in 2025.

technology_title: System and Method for Providing Rapid Virtual Immunohistochemistry (IHC) Staining
expected_inventors: Christopher R. Jackson; Louis J. Vaickus
notes: Exclusively licensed from Dartmouth-Hitchcock Clinic to ViewsML, Inc.; deep learning model predicts biomarker panels directly from routine H&E biopsy slides in minutes without chemical antibody staining.

technology_title: Consolidated Bioprocessing (CBP) of Lignocellulosic Biomass to Ethanol Using Thermophilic Microorganisms
expected_inventors: Arthur Josephus Shaw IV; Sunil G. Desai; Lee R. Lynd
notes: Spun out into Terragia Biofuel (and earlier Mascoma); single-step biological conversion of agricultural cellulose into ethanol without added commercial enzymes or thermochemical pretreatment.

technology_title: Computer-Implemented Perceptual Apparatus and Multi-Core Processing for Neuromorphic Architecture
expected_inventors: Richard Granger; Elijah Floyd William Bowen; Antonio Rodriguez; Andrew Felch
notes: Spun out into Non-Von (founded 2020); custom brain-circuitry neuromorphic hardware ('novo' chip with 3200 cores in 3x4mm) circumventing von Neumann memory bottlenecks for edge AI.

technology_title: Ultra-Light Electromagnetic Array (ULEMA) for Subsurface Anomaly and Ordnance Detection
expected_inventors: Fridon Shubitidze; Max Orman-Kollmar; Irma Shamatava; Jack O'Toole
notes: Spun out into DeepSense Electromagnetics and Consulting (formed Feb 2026); ultralight sensor array for drone/field deployment to detect landmines, unexploded ordnance, and buried municipal lead/copper pipes.

technology_title: Bioresorbable Electrospun Silk and Polyhydroxybutyrate Scaffolds for Soft Tissue Repair
expected_inventors: Rebecca Thomson; Douglas Van Citters
notes: Spun out into NovaGyn (rebranded as Tensara Medical); dissolvable tissue-engineered scaffold replacing permanent polypropylene mesh for stress urinary incontinence.

technology_title: Conductive Bimetallic Metal-Organic Frameworks (MOFs) for Electrochemical Analyte Detection
expected_inventors: Katherine A. Mirica; Lukasz K. Mendecki; Michael Ko; Zheng Meng; Robert M. Stolz; Aileen Eagleton; Aylin Aykanat
notes: Dartmouth Rising Star Innovator Award 2025; porous conductive MOFs integrated into portable electronic sensors for microelectronics, energy, and environmental monitoring.

technology_title: Chimeric NK Receptor and Methods for Treating Cancer (NKG2D CAR T-Cell Platform)
expected_inventors: Tong Zhang; Charles L. Sentman
notes: Pioneering CAR T-cell and NK-cell therapy platform established early at Dartmouth; Sentman lab now extending receptor-engineering from cancer to neurodegenerative diseases (ALS, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's).

technology_title: Monoclonal Antibodies to Fc Receptors for Immunoglobulin G on Human Mononuclear Phagocytes
expected_inventors: Michael W. Fanger; Paul M. Guyre; Clark L. Anderson
notes: Foundational IP of Medarex, Dartmouth's landmark first spin-off (founded 1987, acquired by Bristol-Myers Squibb in 2009 for $2.1B); underpinned over 40 FDA-approved checkpoint inhibitor and monoclonal antibody therapies.

technology_title: Systems and Methods for Multiplexed Amplifiers for Brain-Computer Interfaces (NeuroCROWN)
expected_inventors: Gabriella Shull; Jonathan Viventi; Thomas Jochum; Hui Fang; Michael Trumpis
notes: Part of $2.8M NIH-funded NeuroCROWN initiative; microelectrode array with localized front-end CMOS circuits that simultaneously senses neurochemicals and records electrical activity in brain tissue.

technology_title: Carbon Dioxide Removal via Biochar Fortified by Accelerated Weathering of Basalt
expected_inventors: Mukul Sharma
notes: Geochemical carbon sequestration technology; utilizes basalt nutrients in biochar for soils and seawater clay minerals to bind microalgal carbon and sink fecal pellets into deep ocean.

technology_title: Digital Phenotyping and Generative AI for Personalized Mental Healthcare Monitoring
expected_inventors: Nicholas C. Jacobson
notes: Commercialized via Therabot Labs, LLC; 2026 Dartmouth Rising Star Award; digital health software platform using smartphones and wearables; protected primarily via proprietary software and copyright rather than utility patents.

technology_title: Method and Apparatus for Microwave Thermokeratoplasty and Hyperthermia Therapy
expected_inventors: B. Stuart Trembly; Richard R. Keates
notes: Dartmouth Technology Innovation and Commercialization Award 2019; microwave antenna array delivers controlled thermal therapy to reshape corneal collagen for vision correction and hyperthermia for cancer.

technology_title: Methods for Production of Human-Like Glycoproteins in Pichia Pastoris (GlycoFi Platform)
expected_inventors: Tillman U. Gerngross; Stefan Wildt
notes: Dartmouth Technology Innovation and Commercialization Award 2020; foundation of Dartmouth spin-off GlycoFi (acquired by Merck for $400M); engineered fungal glycosylation machinery to express therapeutic human antibodies.

technology_title: System and Method for Identifying Ictal States in a Patient via Sensor Integration
expected_inventors: Laura E. Ray; Harrison King Saturley-Hall; Jim Lever; Susan Taylor; Erik Kobylarz; Seyed Mahdi Basiri Azad; Dvij Bajpai; Rebecca Butler; Latika Sridhar
notes: Dartmouth Technology Innovation and Commercialization Award 2019; multi-modal acoustic and biometric sensor system with adaptive filtering algorithms for detecting epileptic seizures in real time.

technology_title: Real-Time Multi-Wavelength Fluorescence Color Maps for Surgical Nerve Preservation
expected_inventors: Kimberley Samkoe; Keith D. Paulsen; Ryan Halter; Scott Davis
notes: Funded by $31.3M ARPA-H Precision Surgical Interventions award; dual-probe molecular fluorescence imaging providing live color-coded surgical guidance to prevent cavernous nerve injury during prostate surgery.

technology_title: Repurposing CCR5 Receptor Antagonist (Maraviroc) for Macrophage-Targeted Cancer Immunotherapy
expected_inventors: Claudia Jakubzick
notes: Published in Nature Immunology; repurposes FDA-approved HIV drug Maraviroc to inhibit suppressive macrophage brakes, accelerating anti-tumor response in lung cancer neoantigen vaccine models.

technology_title: Targeted Topical 5-OP-RU MAIT Antigen Formulation for Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus
expected_inventors: Sladjana Skopelja-Gardner
notes: Topical formulation applying mucosal-associated invariant T (MAIT) cell ligand 5-OP-RU to skin to activate regulatory T cells and halt UV-induced cutaneous lupus lesions without systemic immunosuppression.

technology_title: Acousto-Optic Laser Beam Steering and Physics-Based Optical Simulation for High-Speed Imaging
expected_inventors: Adithya Pediredla
notes: Uses ultrasonic waves in crystals to steer laser beams millions of times per second (1000x faster than mechanical galvo mirrors) for non-mechanical LiDAR, underwater optical communication, and 3D imaging.
